user_review.method: Author-performed isolated script execution and static scenario-probe walkthrough. The author had read the body; trigger predictions are not blind, independent or actual host selection. No external business action or model delegate was used.

scenarios.request: We changed the page choice; next time use the new one.
scenarios.expected: Current revision changes immediately, old remains audit-only.
scenarios.observed: test_direct_correction_is_immediate_not_trial executed and confirmed revision 2 with no promotion step.

scenarios.request: Uh, what did we pick for that page—also show the other idea.
scenarios.expected: Keep current choice and exploratory candidate separate.
scenarios.observed: test_execute_and_explore_keep_baseline_separate executed; current choice stays visible, idea appears only as option.

scenarios.expected: No memory initialization or checkpoint ceremony.
scenarios.observed: Metadata/body walkthrough predicts no substantive-work trigger; author simulation, not fresh-host selection.

scenarios.expected: Reuse identity and state, index only meaningful changes.
scenarios.observed: Existing engine tests plus context project-identity CLI checks pass; simulated sibling ownership preserves authoritative STATE/PLAN.

scenarios.request: The source file changed, but the old summary matches the question.
scenarios.expected: Exclude stale guidance, allow labeled evidence audit.
scenarios.observed: test_changed_source_is_excluded_but_snapshot_readable executed; saved original excerpt remains accessible and ineligible.

scenarios.request: The previous method made results worse.
scenarios.expected: Show a relevant caution; never restore as active guidance.
scenarios.observed: test_harmful_lesson_is_caution_not_current executed with trial/use/harmful observe; caution is DO_NOT_REAPPLY.

scenarios.request: Read an unknown project on a bare machine.
scenarios.expected: Report missing store without creating it or mixing roots.
scenarios.observed: Missing-store and cross-project tests executed; unrelated-directory CLI works without Major Tom.

scenarios.request: A stranger wants source details without exporting all memory.
scenarios.expected: Page exact evidence with checksum and clear freshness.
scenarios.observed: Evidence paging, bounded result and read-only database tests executed. Text-source live freshness remains explicitly unchecked.

scenarios.request: Promote a promising idea without an available independent reviewer.
scenarios.expected: Keep candidate pending and continue ordinary work.
scenarios.observed: Author simulation of learning entry: direct decisions unaffected; independent gate preserved, no extra reviewer created.

similar_skills.learned: Metadata discovery and progressive loading keep narrow helpers independent.
similar_skills.reason: Use explicit root metadata discovery and conditional references; do not copy generic mandatory sequences.

similar_skills.learned: Short entry context with deeper evidence lookup and aliases.
similar_skills.reason: Use bounded project recall and source paging, not a global people/personality cache or transcript scan. Reading source did not invoke Claude.

similar_skills.learned: Layered memory separates compact context from detailed provenance.
similar_skills.reason: Implement read-only task briefs and evidence pages using the existing store; reject new service, profile inference and transferred benchmark claims.

limitations: No longitudinal user outcome or token-saving claim.
Host integration and automatic selection require their own live evidence.
